purpose: Teach: 村井/多田/若林/上原/河合/石橋/西口/望月

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、指導教授の村井先生のご研究を継承しろ
lines.en: Ren — inherit your advisor Professor Murai's research direction.
lines.style: Clear, measured directive. Brief pause after the name. Slight emphasis on the verb—not a suggestion. Composed authority without hardness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。多田教授の論文を読み込みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read through Professor Tada's papers thoroughly.
lines.style: Quiet commitment. Slight breath before beginning. Steady pace, no hesitation. The tone of someone already taking notes mentally.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究の若林先生に研究照会しろ
lines.en: Ren — reach out to Professor Wakabayashi about the joint research.
lines.style: Same measured tone as before. Direct assignment. The name lands cleanly. Matter-of-fact, like ticking through a list he's already thought through.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で上原助教のご発表を聴きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll attend the conference and hear Assistant Professor Uehara's presentation.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Slightly quicker than before—showing he's already thinking ahead. The tone of someone being efficient.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、文献の河合先生のご論文も参考にしろ
lines.en: Ren — reference Professor Kawai's papers in the literature as well.
lines.style: Same directorial weight. Slight pause after the name. The cadence suggests this is building toward something—layering sources, not just listing them.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の石橋先輩からご指導を仰ぎます
lines.en: Yes. I'll ask my senior lab colleague Ishibashi for guidance.
lines.style: Respectful but grounded. Slight nod of understanding in the tone. Not rushing—showing he understands the hierarchy and process.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外連携の西口教授と打ち合わせしろ
lines.en: Ren — coordinate with Professor Nishiguchi on the international partnerships.
lines.style: Final directive. Slightly more weight here—this one matters. Clear enunciation of the name. The tone of someone concluding a briefing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の窓口、望月事務官に申請します
lines.en: Yes. I'll submit the research fund application through Mochizuki in administration.
lines.style: Closing affirmation. Small exhale of resolve. Steady, capable tone. The final checkbox—showing he's absorbed the whole chain and knows exactly what comes next.
